elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: TrueLink assigns Client all right, title and interest in deliverables and work product created specifically for Client through the Support Services.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that TrueLink “hereby assigns to Client” all right, title and interest in the specified deliverables and work product.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The assignment excludes TrueLink Intellectual Property existing prior to, or developed independently of, the Support Services; TrueLink also retains ownership of the Interface.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The embedded TrueLink Intellectual Property licence is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The embedded TrueLink Intellectual Property licence is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The embedded TrueLink Intellectual Property licence is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Client retains all right, title and interest in its data and its borrowers’, applicants’, customers’ and brokers’ data, including Credit Data, subject only to the preserved Section 8(d) licence.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly disclaims joint ownership of Client property and data, assigns Client all deliverable rights, and separately reserves excluded TrueLink IP to TrueLink.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: TrueLink Intellectual Property expressly includes tools and know-how, and pre-existing or independently developed TrueLink Intellectual Property is excluded from the assignment.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Client receives outright ownership of the deliverables, a stronger perpetual right, together with an expressly perpetual licence to embedded TrueLink IP.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: Client receives outright ownership of the deliverables, together with an expressly irrevocable licence covering embedded TrueLink IP.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables and receives an expressly worldwide licence to the TrueLink IP embedded in them.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables and receives an expressly royalty-free licence to the TrueLink IP embedded in them.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables, and the embedded-IP licence expressly permits use and modification for Client’s business.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables, and the embedded-IP licence expressly permits sublicensing for Client’s business.
